worldcombat.skill.spinout.summary: Slide along your aim, then swing sideways to slam the first foe and knock it back. The uncontrolled turn sharply lowers your Speed after a hit. You cannot steer after departure; a miss or wall collision causes no Speed loss. Charging first increases reach and impact but takes longer to prepare and recover.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.use.0: Slide flat and swing in to one target for a heavy single blow
worldcombat.skill.spinout.use.1: Knock a target off position with the curved charge and spin on to the next
worldcombat.skill.spinout.use.2: Trade the heaviest self-slowing for a key target, or spin out as limited lateral movement
worldcombat.skill.spinout.description.0: Drop low and slide flat: straight along the aim for the first half, then swinging to the chosen side; only the first target it meets takes about %1$s contact physical damage; total travel up to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.description.1: A landed hit knocks the target %1$s blocks along the charge (heavier targets move less) and lowers the user's Speed by the real amount (about %2$s stage(s); less or none at the minimum) - a price paid only when the hit connects.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.description.2: The spin advances %1$s blocks per tick along its current curved heading and never chases after release; hitting a wall or spending the full travel ends it with a whiff - no damage and no slow-down.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.description.3: The second half bends a total of about %1$s degrees left or right, dragging a matching curved wheel track; repeating the same direction never randomly swaps sides.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.preload.on: Wind-up form: gathers itself first; charge range x1.2, charge speed x1.15 and power x1.1; costs wind-up +4 ticks, recovery +2 ticks, cooldown +8 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.preload.off: Instant form: spins the moment the legs load, a fast, short-cooldown cast, but charges less far and hits lighter.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.growth.0: From level %1$s the strike power rises to %2$s and the knock-back to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.growth.1: From level %1$s the strike power rises to %2$s and the charge range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.preference.pre: On: gathers itself first; charge range x1.2, charge speed x1.15 and power x1.1; costs wind-up +4 ticks, recovery +2 ticks, cooldown +8 ticks. Off (instant): spins as soon as the legs load, fast with a short cooldown, but charges less far and hits lighter.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens the charge from farther, but it is easier to sidestep mid-charge.

On: low-health targets rank higher so one heavy moving blow finishes them and the slow-down is spent settling the fight; off: all targets score the same. The user lowers its own priority when already slow or when both sides lack room.
world_combat.move.spinout.text.redirect: Path blocked: swings the other way
